question: For the fatty acid that dominates the macaw palm almond oil measured in the heat-transfer fluid study, what share did Goncalves report?
rendered: Gonçalves reported that lauric acid (C12:0) accounted for 39.36% of the fatty acid composition of macaw palm almond oil.
